operations.description: Load the details about all the hotels your application has access to.

operations.description:
With this call you can find codes for a hotel by type or code. By default and without any filter criteria
            defined it will return you all available codes.

operations.description: Read the details about a specific code available for the defined hotel.

operations.description:

            defined it will return you all active rateplans.

operations.summary: Get the count of all rateplans in the hotel matching the given filter criteria.

operations.description:
With this call you can read the daily rates setup including the cancellation policy and minimum guarantee per day for the
            specified rateplan. You can specify a timeperiod to read the daily rates for. The rateplan needs to be active for at least
            one business day in the defined time period and have rates loaded.
operations.summary: Get the setup of the daily rates for a specific rateplan and a defined timeperiod.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] rate plans rates [PATH] hotel v 0 hotels rateplans rates [PARAMS] app code expand from hotel id inlinecount key rateplan skip to top [SCHEMA] derivation link object policy price rate rates response room supplement type

operations.summary: Get the count of all active and loaded daily rates for the defined rateplan in a specified time period.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] rate plans rates count [PATH] hotel v 0 hotels rateplans rates count [PARAMS] app code from hotel id key rateplan to [SCHEMA] count response total

operations.description: Read the setup of the daily rate for the defined rateplan for that specific business day.

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] rate plans rate [PATH] hotel v 0 hotels rateplans rates [PARAMS] app business code day hotel id key rateplan [SCHEMA] derivation link object policy price rate response room supplement type

operations.description:
The hetras API is using this Patch Specification to partially update an existing resource. Currently this call only allows to set the base price for non-derived rateplans if the rateplan is active and already loaded for the specified time period.

A request example:
            [
              {
                "op": "replace", "path": "/base_price", "value": 120.00
              }
            ]

For more details on how the API responds to errors please check our documentation on Error Handling.
operations.summary: Partially update a rate of the specified rateplan for the defined time period.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] rate plans patch rates [PATH] hotel v 0 hotels rateplans rates [PARAMS] app code from hotel id key rateplan to [SCHEMA] document json object operation patch rate request

A request example:
            [

operations.description:
Saves Yieldable Rate Prices for existing Yieldable Rateplan. The rateplan has been created before and with this End Point we create or update the rate prices. If the Yieldable rateplan prices exist it updates them with the new price if not it creates new price entries.
For more details on how the API responds to errors please check our documentation on Error Handling.
operations.summary: Saves Yieldable Rate Prices for existing Yieldable Rateplan.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] yieldable rates save prices [PATH] hotel v 0 hotels yieldable rateplans rates [PARAMS] app code hotel id key rateplan [SCHEMA] object rate slice time yieldable
